children: Democrats could support approximately $1 trillion in defense funding, Bloomberg News reported, citing a person familiar with their planning. Incoming House Armed Services Committee Chairman Adam Smith has called for a more restrained budget that protects domestic programs.

The resistance threatens Trump’s Golden Dome missile-defense initiative and proposed Trump-class battleships. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has argued that higher spending is necessary to modernize the military as autonomous weapons reshape warfare.

Congress must address fiscal 2027 appropriations before temporary funding expires Dec. 11. Some Democrats favor another short-term extension, allowing their incoming majorities to shape spending legislation after taking office in January.

Republicans could struggle to pass the larger package during the lame-duck session. The proposal includes $350 billion intended for separate party-line legislation, while disputes over Iran war funding and efforts to impeach Hegseth further complicate negotiations. Contractors face uncertainty over both funding levels and the timing of awards.
